units: seconds unless a field is explicitly labelled ns or us
camera_mapping: Map the driver buffer timestamp to host MONOTONIC_RAW using the clock samples of the current run. CNTVCT was the plausible domain here.
validity: The example reference, slope and intercept belong to this capture. Estimate clock mappings again for a new session; apply the residual timeshift once on that basis.
spatial_convention: cam_imu.yaml: T_cam_imu maps IMU to camera; orb_trial.yaml: IMU.T_b_c1 is its inverse and maps camera to IMU. Translation metres.

run_03_imu_to_host_receipt_model_example.method: Centered relative times. Median of secant slopes between 32 or fewer block medians separated by >=1/4 span, then median intercept. Residuals include serial/USB/read scheduling latency.
